---
title: Indoor Smoke Barbecue Ribs
yield: 2 racks
tags: [ribs, barbecue, oven, indoor-smoke]
---

== step prep ==
Cut @St. Louis-style ribs{2%racks}[weight_each=2.5 lb, scale=true, step=1] in half so they fit in the brine.
Any pork rib style will work.

== step brine ==
Mix @water{3%qt}, @kosher salt{3/4%cup}[brand=diamond-crystal],
@sugar{1/3%cup}, and @liquid smoke{1/4%cup}.

Submerge the ribs in the brine, cover with plastic, and refrigerate for
~brine{1-4%hours}. Do not go longer; the liquid smoke can take over.

== step rub ==
Remove the ribs from the brine and pat them dry.

Mix @kosher salt{1.5%tbsp}, @black pepper{2%tbsp},
@granulated garlic{1%tbsp}, and @cayenne{1/4%tsp}.

Sprinkle both sides of the ribs with the dry rub.

== step first cook ==
Cook the ribs on the middle rack at $temp{275%F} for ~first cook{2.5%hours}.

== step glaze ==
Remove the ribs from the oven, brush with @barbecue sauce{}, and return them
to the oven at $temp{275%F} for ~second cook{2.5%hours}.

== step rest ==
Remove the ribs from the oven. They are ready, but need to rest.
Brush with more @barbecue sauce{} and rest covered in foil for ~rest{30%minutes}.
